proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding GHG Emissions Targets
proposals.proponent: Follow This (on behalf of Benta B.V.)
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the company set and publish quantitative GHG emissions targets consistent with the Paris Agreement covering Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions, and report on strategy and progress annually.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote "AGAINST" proposal 5.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Regarding Report on Shift to Recycled Polymer for Single Use Plastics
proposals.proponent: As You Sow (on behalf of Handlery Hotels, Inc.)
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report, with board oversight, describing how the company could shift its plastic resin business from virgin to recycled polymer production to reduce ocean plastic pollution.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote "AGAINST" proposal 6.
